title: Spec: DTN store-and-forward in spec/07-transport-app.md
description: Add section defining DTN store semantics. DTN store is separate from real-time TX/forward queues. Opt-in per message via CoAP option (DTN-TTL). Stored messages persist to flash/disk (survive reboot). Custody transfer: storing node ACKs sender so sender stops retransmitting. Explicit TTL set by sender (5min/1hr/24hr). Node class determines store size: leaf=none, router=4 msgs RAM, relay=256 msgs flash, gateway=4096+ disk. Verify: markdown renders.
